p: is a tradition of ours … from our ancestors: … spies were named after their actions,
is a tradition of ours that was passed down to us from our ancestors: The spies were named after their actions,
Sethur, as he hid [satar] the actions of the Holy One, Blessed be He. … Michael, … as he made Him, … weak [makh]

Sethur, as he hid [satar] the actions of the Holy One, Blessed be He. In other words, he ignored the miracles that God performed for the Jewish people in Egypt and in the wilderness. He is called Michael, as he made Him, God, appear weak [makh]
Nahbi, as he concealed [heḥbi] the statement of the Holy One, Blessed be He,
Vophsi, as he stomped [pisse’a] on the attributes of the Holy One, Blessed be He,
